study_role: prospective software/runtime intervention study; never reinterpret or reopen the closed 358H hardware campaign

fixed_semantics.target: Qwen3-8B Q8_0 on explicit llama.cpp Vulkan0
fixed_semantics.draft: same frozen Qwen3-0.6B OpenVINO INT4 IR
fixed_semantics.acceptance: ordered prefix; stop at first mismatch
fixed_semantics.correction: one target token at first mismatch
fixed_semantics.bonus: one target token after complete draft acceptance
fixed_semantics.primary_timing_boundary: post target-prompt-prefill in target worker; all target-draft RPCs and draft BEGIN/FINISH charged; driver-target harness dispatch excluded
fixed_semantics.host_allocation: one identical process CPU-affinity mask for every R2 condition; no CPU-draft-only affinity asymmetry

research_questions.rq1: Can persistent/reconcilable draft state reduce realized draft-subsystem cost relative to full committed-prefix replay without changing token semantics?
research_questions.rq2: Can a physically wider target verification path (n_ubatch=2) pass the active exact-output contract and reduce target-side realized cost?
research_questions.rq3: After counting every state-management and target-side cost, does a correctness-qualified combined runtime path improve post-prefill decode time relative to target-only?
research_questions.rq4: If a component improves but the whole path remains unprofitable, can the runtime expose that outcome without relabeling it as a system speedup?

R0.purpose: capability discovery, API-compatibility work, and forced state-machine qualification before source/environment freeze
required: OpenVINO model I/O and query_state capability inventory
request reset and cross-request leakage test
target UB1 and UB2 binding/state tests
R0.repair_rule: API-compatibility repairs are allowed only in R0; after the freeze manifest is generated, any semantic/runtime source or package change invalidates R1/R2 qualification

R1.purpose: correctness qualification of complete candidate execution paths before performance promotion

small_gate.pass_rule: all paired generated token-ID sequences exactly equal the shared UB1 target-only reference

full_gate.pass_rule: 90/90 exact pairs; one mismatch blocks the path from performance promotion

R2.purpose: paired component and end-to-end comparison of only R0-feasible and R1-qualified paths
R2.condition_selection: deterministic from R0 feasibility and R1 exactness only; never from observed performance
R2.schedule: within each task/repetition block, randomize all eligible conditions using a frozen seed
R2.warmup: HumanEval/0 only; non-formal and excluded from estimators
R2.process_affinity: capture one session affinity mask before initialization and apply the identical mask to every condition

target_ub2_correctness_gate.name: TARGET_UB2
target_ub2_correctness_gate.role: R0/R1 correctness gate only; target-only single-token decode does not exercise a two-token verification microbatch and is not an R2 timing condition

legacy_replay.role: contemporaneous bridge to the closed Phase-3 mechanism

same_frontend_replay.draft_frontend: state-capable OpenVINO/Optimum adapter selected and frozen in R0
same_frontend_replay.role: control for frontend changes when estimating state-reuse benefit

persistent_ub2.promotion: only if TARGET_UB2 and both PERSIST_NPU_UB1/PERSIST_NPU_UB2 satisfy R0 feasibility and R1 exactness

legacy_replay_ub2_fallback.promotion: only as the predeclared NPU UB2 fallback when persistent NPU UB2 is unavailable/blocked and TARGET_UB2 plus the LEGACY_NPU UB1/UB2 pair qualify

hard_block_rules: any generated-token mismatch against the active target-only reference
requested execution device differs from actual execution device
AUTO, MULTI, HETERO, or silent CPU inference fallback for a single-device claim
persistent path performs hidden full-prefix replay after begin unless that fallback is explicitly surfaced and charged
draft logical history differs from committed orchestrator history after reconcile
target KV/logical history differs from committed orchestrator history
runtime-specific setup/checkpoint/reconcile/cleanup moved outside the primary measured decode boundary
formal condition chosen using R1 or R2 timing performance
R2 process CPU affinity differs across conditions
source commit, frozen file hash, model/data hash, or frozen Python package version differs from the preexecution freeze manifest

estimators.primary_system: for each prompt take the median paired TARGET_UB1/runtime speedup across repetitions; report geometric mean across 30 prompts
estimators.primary_component: same-frontend replay versus persistent complete draft-subsystem time using prompt-level paired ratios; draft begin/checkpoint/propose/reconcile/finish are all included
estimators.target_path: for a jointly qualified same-policy NPU UB1/UB2 pair, compare complete target_verification_ns using prompt-level paired ratios
secondary: mean committed tokens per speculative round C

interpretation_rules: reduced draft cost with total speedup <= 1 is component improvement without overall profitability
a correctness-blocked path retains diagnostic timing only
an unavailable NPU state API is IMPLEMENTATION UNAVAILABLE, not a reason to substitute CPU/AUTO/replay and call it persistent NPU
OpenVINO NPU VariableState copying, if used, is part of the measured state-management cost rather than free persistence
no result changes the scientific status of the closed hardware campaign

deferred.profitability_guard: architecture hook may be implemented, but no formal adaptive-policy claim is made in R2; a measured guard requires a separately frozen R3 protocol

revision_reason: v0.1 single-process target/draft failed with OpenMP Error #15 on the tested 358H Windows stack

process_topology.driver: backend-neutral; harness dispatch excluded from primary timer
process_topology.target_worker: pinned llama.cpp target, UB1/UB2 contexts, speculative orchestration and primary timer
process_topology.draft_worker: physical OpenVINO/Optimum or GenAI engine, state checkpoint/reconcile; no target backend
process_topology.transport: synchronous multiprocessing.Pipe; small token/metadata messages only; no state tensor crosses IPC
process_topology.engine_control: one Optimum compiled engine per device shared serially by replay and persistent policies

timing_v02.primary_timer: target worker; starts after target prompt prefill; stops after draft FINISH/reset
timing_v02.rq1_cost: sum of target-worker realized Draft RPC durations, including serialization, IPC, worker scheduling and computation

new_hard_blocks: draft worker imports llama target backend
RPC/request identity mismatch or stale response
unrecorded worker restart or silent crash retry
draft RPC excluded from end-to-end timer
worker internal timing substituted for realized RPC cost
